notes: Printed: 'When this creature dies, it deals 3 damage to any target.' The Beater's 5 damage kills the Devils; the dies trigger should ask for a target and leave 3 marks on the Victim.
finding: SILENT: no target ask is ever made and the damage ledger stays empty (zone lane confirms the Devils DID die). Root cause is the self-dies law in MTG_bot/core/executor/binding.py: the binder DETACHES a permanent's triggers on the ZONE_CHANGE journal row, and CREATURE_DIES rows are journalled AFTER zone changes - so an IS_SOURCE 'when this creature dies' trigger is already unregistered when its own dies event fires. Every IS_SOURCE dies trigger in the corpus is structurally dead (compare Spirit of Malevolence). FIX belongs to the binder's event ordering (fire IS_SOURCE dies triggers before/independently of the detach), not the pack.
